name: Prenylamine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1989 — for heart harm

similar.name: Amphetamine
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for misuse or addiction and heart harm

similar.name: Terodiline
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1991 — for heart harm

similar.name: Benfluorex
problems: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2009 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: Prenylamine was removed from the market worldwide starting in 1989 because of heart harm [3]. In results from a small computer model rather than human tests, it received a low score for liver harm and a high score for heart harm [M]. Drugs with similar properties also have warnings or were withdrawn, including amphetamine for misuse and heart harm, terodiline for heart harm, and benfluorex for breathing and heart harm [4][5][6].
